newsitem.title: DENMARK: Unidanmark denies S-E Banken merger rumours.
newsitem.headline: Unidanmark denies S-E Banken merger rumours.

text.p: Denmark's second biggest bank, Unidanmark on Tuesday dismissed market and media rumours of merger talks with Sweden's S-E Banken as totally without foundation.
"There is no truth in these rumours," Unidanmark Chief Executive Thorleif Krarup told Reuters.
Sweden's financial daily Dagens Industri wrote on Tuesday of rumours in Stockholm's financial sector of merger negotiations between Unidanmark and S-E Banken, fuelling market speculation.
Krarup called the Dagens Industri article "speculative" and rejected its content completely.
He added that the time was not ripe for cross-border mergers in the Nordic region.

"Our strategy is a mix of small takeovers, such as (Swedish brokerage firm) Aros and efforts to extend the present market," Krarup said. "Unidanmark has no plans for the time being to engage in major cross-border mergers."

Dagens Industri also mentioned Denmark's biggest bank, Den Danske Bank, as a possible merger partner for S-E Banken but Den Danske Bank Managing Director Knud Soerensen recently told Reuters he ruled out any Nordic bank mergers at the present time.
